name: ReClor
description: Reading Comprehension dataset requiring Logical Reasoning, collected from LSAT and GMAT logical reasoning questions. Tests complex logical relationships in reading passages including arguments, assumptions, inferences, and flaws.
reputation: Widely used logical reasoning benchmark from standardized test material; harder than many NLI benchmarks; used to evaluate reasoning in LLMs
notes: Questions require understanding arguments, identifying assumptions, drawing conclusions. Source material from LSAT and GMAT ensures high-quality logical structure. Hidden test set requires server submission.
